Questions.Question: Document length
Questions.Description: Optimization scenarios are consistently compared against the baseline to assess improvements or trade-offs.

Questions.Question: Clarity of research question
Questions.Description: The paper states a clear, focused research question that guides the modeling work.

Feedback.Text: No clear research question could be identified.

Questions.Question: Use of literature
Questions.Description: Relevant literature is cited to support modeling assumptions and design choices.

Feedback.Text: Little to no literature was used to support the work.
Some literature is used but not consistently connected to the arguments made.
Literature is well integrated and clearly supports the arguments.

Questions.Question: Baseline comparison
Questions.Description: Optimization scenarios are consistently compared against a defined baseline.

Feedback.Text: A baseline is mentioned but comparisons are incomplete or inconsistent.
Scenarios are consistently and clearly compared against the baseline.
